title: Magmafish

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Magmafish are passive creatures (fish) found in the waters of the Ashlands biome.
They can be caught with a fishing pole using Hot fishing bait which can be made at the Food preparation table by combining 20 Fishing bait and a Warrior trophy.
Needed to craft a Fishing hat

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Has a unique line: "Please lay me to rest by the fire..."
